isolation: Primary run used unique origin http://127.0.0.1:47118; independent self-review used new origin http://127.0.0.1:47218. Neither origin had prior case storage. Each Vite process was started fresh and stopped afterward.

actions.action: Primary run opened and hid Google's interview details from Browse Experiences.
Independent self-review recorded the URL and link inventory before opening details.
Clicked Show Interview Details and recorded the URL and remaining article list.

observations: The detail is only an inline disclosure inside the list.
The URL stayed at the root, the page exposes no experience links, and all three list articles remained visible while Google's details were expanded.
There is no individual experience detail page to navigate to or back from.
notes: The UI can expand details inline, but it does not provide the required list-to-individual-detail-page navigation.
